title: Crossword Puzzles and Clues
hook: Data this week comes from Cryptic Crossword Clues. A short TDS article on Crosswords cryptics.georgeho.org is a dataset of cryptic crossword1 clues, indicators and charades, collected from various blogs and digital archives. This dataset is a significant work of crossword archivism and scholarship, as acquiring historical crosswords and structuring their contents require focused effort and tedious cleaning that few are willing to do for such trivial data - for example, according to this selection guide2, the Library of Congress explicitly does not collect crossword puzzles. This project indexes various blogs and digital archives for cryptic crosswords. Several fields - such as clues, answers, clue numbers, annotations or commentary, puzzle title and publication date - are parsed and extracted into a tabular dataset.
